encoding.runtimeActualAmounts: all amounts multiplied exactly by2; .5/1/1.5 => 1/2/3; every model uses the same units
encoding.why: Current product input requires safe integer quantities. Linear exact unit rescaling preserves every completion date and N=5; variable true amounts are never replaced by DONE counts.

random.streamDerivation: first uint32 little-endian of SHA256(UTF8 JSON.stringify([protocolVersion,familyId,rootSeed,stage,replicate,channel])); if0 use0x9e3779b9
random.schedule: each day consume one uniform from every channel, regardless of status; renewal channel selects a newly entered spell or origin conditional residual total length; future streams reinitialized independently
random.noSelection: all four seeds in each family; no tuning or replacement after generation, including failure or timeout

families.mechanism: independent daily Bernoulli by UTC weekday
independent daily Bernoulli with external probability change
families.boundary: after probability starts on changeDay; changes at61 are unforeseen future shocks

families.futureConditioning: At origin retain actual current state and its elapsed age only for scorer/generator; each future independently samples total spell L from mass conditioned on L>=age. Do not retain the pre-sampled latent total L from history generation. Models receive only observed logs, no latent total or uncapped true age.

families.mechanism: independent daily Bernoulli with periodic external deadline
iid status with independent positive actual quantity
families.completionTruth: sum actual future amounts reaches5, not five DONE events

families.mechanism: latent iid status with observed-record omission
families.boundary: forced intervals apply to history only; future omissions use the same MCAR/MNAR probabilities. Missing statuses remain hidden from model and are never converted to SKIPPED.

literature.evidence: Doherty2017 day-of-week physical activity differences; measured weekday/weekend effect is small, not synthetic .60/.25
Tison2020 external changes in physical activity; step-count changes are not converted to daily DONE probabilities
Peach2019 temporal heterogeneity of learner activity; chosen alternating run lengths and probabilities are stress assumptions
Barenberg2018 temporal concentration of learning near examinations; period14 and .80/.15 are stress assumptions
HABITAT2023 day-to-day variability; chosen three-point quantity distribution is a stress assumption
Cho2025 PA aggregate missing18.4% is the sole borrowed numeric rate; independent MCAR, conditional MNAR rates and interval placement are assumptions

sourceFreeze.rule: Use only these byte-exact sources for this run. A different source requires a separate pre-results protocol/run identity; no mixed-source results.

candidate.entryPoint: C computeLearningExperiment on recorded history only

legacy.observations: all real observed adjacent pairs through origin; no unknown-day interpolation or synthetic Today posterior update
legacy.cdf: existing baselineCompletionCdf on the observed posterior and common current-state scenario

simple.cdf: beta-binomial predictive Pr(number future DONE>=5) for t0..30; fixed quantity assumption remains explicit

currentContext.ifOriginRecorded: use observed day60 status and canonical observed restDays
currentContext.ifOriginUnrecorded: retain U in training and source log; use existing R11 TODAY_DONE hypothetical initial DONE for forecast only, without inserting into fit or transition counts; known residual5 is defined after this hypothetical action. Tag hypothetical=true. Synthetic hidden day60 state is not passed to models.
currentContext.why: The confirmed missing54..60 case has no observed current state. This uses the existing R11 scenario rather than inventing a true state or modifying the omission protocol.
currentContext.newGoal: known residual5 is a fresh forecast query at the fixed origin, not one longitudinal Goal and not adoption-gate evidence

truth.futureModelLeakage: no future states, amounts, missing masks, latent generator parameters or latent spell length enter fitting/forecasting
truth.labels: cumulative actual scaled quantity>=10, day1..30; preserve after30 tail
truth.illustrativeFuture: replicate0 only, predetermined; primary scoring uses all256

metrics.primary: mean RPS across256 future continuations, t1..30 unrenormalized
secondary: finite P50/P80 output rates over32 forecast contexts
conditional P50/P80 coverage counts/256 when quantile finite
max observed CDF discrepancy to MC empirical process, diagnostic
future labels observable from omitted records, separate from oracle truth
metrics.mcUncertainty: per context Wilson95 pointwise intervals for coverage success/256; not simultaneous certification and not confidence in real-user calibration

comparisons.candidateOnly: raw insufficiency has null CDF/quantiles; paired model score comparisons use the identical candidate-available contexts and list the missing count
comparisons.operationalFallback: candidate when numerically available, otherwise fixed-MID existing legacy; expose selected source/reason. Scores reported over all32 if legacy is available; if not, preserve unscorable context and shared eligible denominator.
comparisons.adoption: old singleGoal gate remains HOLD/not assessed; availability or stress score does not grant eligibility
comparisons.statistics: four observed histories per family; 256 conditional futures per history are MC repetitions, not8192 independent people; no significance or calibration proof
comparisons.outcomes: all32 contexts recorded, including failures. Worse precision or calibration is retained, not an implementation acceptance failure

budget.expectedExtraSimulationWork: 245760 future days, no extra fits/forecasts; wall time unmeasured
budget.internalLimits: preserve existing H<=30/100m DP estimate/1m hazard/32→64/tolerance
budget.stop: persist every context as complete, failed, timeout or unrun-budget; no losing-seed replacement or result-driven tuning

implementationAcceptance: valid monotone CDF and retained tail
no finite P80 forced to H
single fit once per history and frozen forecast across256 futures
future continuation respects true terminal state/age, never pre-sampled latent length
scope: local synthetic scripts/artifacts only; no product source edits, private real-data fit, DB/HTTP, GitHub push or PR; preserve old96 evidence and source freeze
